stories.title: Define Specialty Match Score schema and contract
stories.description: Create a Pydantic model and internal schema for specialty match scoring output, including fields for requested specialty, matched NUCC codes, match confidence score (0-1), and explanation metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing provider search and evaluation flows.

stories.title: Implement specialty match scoring logic
stories.description: Extend specialty_service or create evaluation module to compute alignment score between user-requested specialty/condition and provider NUCC taxonomy. Use existing regex + vector expansion pipeline and assign weighted scoring based on exact match, partial match, and inferred relevance.

stories.title: Expose specialty score via Evaluate Care facade
stories.description: Integrate specialty match scoring into evaluate_care_facade so that provider evaluation responses include specialty alignment score and supporting metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing provider detail lookup and evaluation orchestration.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for specialty scoring
stories.description: Create unit tests for scoring logic (exact, partial, no match cases) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow through facade. Validate score consistency and edge cases (multiple specialties, ambiguous queries).
